info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Drivers-v1-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Driver Listings API enables users to fetch a comprehensive list of available rideshare drivers in a specified area. This endpoint caters to businesses and applications that require real-time data on drivers, facilitating efficient ride matching and scheduling. Typical consumers include rideshare platforms, mobile applications, and transportation management systems seeking to enhance user experience with driver availability information. With this API, developers can seamlessly integrate essential rideshare functionalities into their services, improving overall operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all rides associated with a specific driver. It provides detailed information about each ride, including status, pickup and drop-off locations, and timestamps.

requestBody.description: This request body contains details necessary for fetching information related to a driver's rides. It ensures that the request is properly formatted to retrieve the most relevant ride data.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the driver ride information.
